claims.text: Per the EULA, licenses may not be used to process third-party data
Restriction lifted by rental licenses through VCSP program for hosting and managed services
Must report license usage to Veeam each month and be able to access reporting for the customer environment
Rental report includes licensed workloads, license info, processed workloads, machines and job types
VSPC Rental license requires monthly usage report; workloads can be viewed/adjusted before submitting
Managed Service: SP deploys VBR and Agents on tenant side and must install Rental VBR license for total instances
MSP must install Rental VBR license for total instances the tenant plans to protect
Veeam provides this Rental license to service providers
Rental license used on tenant backup servers, not on the SP backup server
Rental license includes a license usage report for managed VMs
Community Edition licensing prohibited for managing/protecting third-party data per EULA
To back up tenants to tape, need Veeam Cloud Connect SP license on backup server

B.notes: Misses the EULA third-party restriction in general, VCSP lifting it, and the monthly reporting commitment; [3] (same text as [1]) does not say Veeam provides the license.

A.notes: Abstains; cited details only explain what the sources cover and are supported.
